rules.description: There shall be no dead code. This includes unreachable code and statements with no side effects.
There shall be no unused parameters in functions.

rules.rule_name: Octal constants shall not be used
rules.description: Octal constants and octal escape sequences shall not be used.
A compatible declaration shall be visible when an object or function with external linkage is defined.

rules.rule_name: Objects should have block scope whenever possible
rules.description: An object with external linkage shall have file scope or block scope if it is only referenced in a single function.
The value of an expression shall not be assigned to an object with a narrower essential type or of a different essential type category without an explicit cast.
The precedence of operators within expressions should be made explicit by using parentheses.
The controlling expression of an if-statement or an iteration-statement shall have essentially Boolean type.
An unconditional break statement shall terminate every non-empty switch clause.

rules.rule_name: Every switch statement shall have a default clause
rules.description: Every switch statement shall have a default clause.
